descriptionChirho: A natural or artificial body of standing water, used for water storage or irrigation. Hebrew berēkāh denotes a pool or pond, cognate with Arabic birkah. Attested in references to specific named pools (pool of Gibeon, pool of Samaria, pool of Siloam, pool of Heshbon) as well as generic pools. All occurrences share the same core meaning regardless of morphological form (absolute, construct, plural, or with preposition).
